properties.digitized_from: Mission Rock Design Controls, Figure 6.2 (p.151), Figure 3.1.1 - Location Map of Open Spaces (p.45) and Section 3.4 Channel Lane (p.66).
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-17 (site-completeness pass against Design Controls Figure 3.1.1, which names six open spaces; this one was missing). Channel Lane is the pedestrian open space between Blocks J and I, from Bridgeview Street to Terry A Francois Boulevard, continuing the Channel Street / Mission Rock Square axis to Channel Wharf. Figures 1.1 and 3.1.1 fill exactly the J-to-I gap, so the polygon is Block J's two traced southern corners and Block I's two traced northern corners (both traced through the Figure 6.2 transform described in mission_rock_block_c.geojson: 0.7 m RMS on 16 real lot corners), touching both blocks exactly. Gap 21.8 m = 71 ft, matching Standard 3.4.1 (10 ft active edges along J and I plus a 50 ft maximum plaza). Area 10,272 sf. Not registered in verify_block_fill.py: no fill colour on Figure 6.2; it is derived from the registered J and I traces.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE (planned, unbuilt) on the undivided remainder lot 8719A006; edges are Blocks J's and I's traced edges (~1-3 m) and the TAFB property line / unbuilt Bridgeview Street line.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor lot exists under this open space -- 8719A006, the undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 recorded 2020-06-12 -- but it has not been subdivided per block, so joining status.csv to it would paint the same ~9-acre parking-lot shape for every unbuilt block. Hand-derived geometry is used instead, with the lot's own lines wherever this open space touches them.
properties.regulatory_context: Dedicated open space, Design Controls Section 3.4: a 50 ft maximum plaza with a 12 ft pedestrian throughway, not accessible by vehicles, a protected view corridor from Mission Rock Square to the Bay, connecting across Terry A Francois Boulevard to Channel Wharf.
properties.notes: Planned pedestrian lane between Blocks J and I, not yet built (surface parking today).
